Manx: Keayrt dy row va tree braaraghyn ayn. V'ad goll raad cam 'sy choleayrtys.
Lurg tammylt, raink ny braaraghyn awin va ro chryggylagh dy chosney shaghey.
Agh mie ynsit ayns ny h-ellynyn druiaghtagh,
cha ren ny tree braaraghyn agh craa ny slattyn obbee oc as ren ad droghad.
Agh roish my row caa daue goll harrish,
hooar ad magh dy row yn raad oc dooint liorish peiagh ennagh ayns cloagey bayrnagh.
She Baase v'ayn, as v'eh gennaghtyn dy ve mollit . . . mollit er yn
oyr dy row troailtee dy cadjin cheet dy ve baiht 'syn awin. Agh s'croutagh va Baase.
Ren eh lhiggey er dy voylley ny tree braaraghyn son yn druiaghtys oc,
as dooyrt eh dy row cagh feeu aundyr,
as adsyn cho aghtal as dy haghney eh.
Y fer shinney, hirr eshyn slat obbee ny stroshey na fer erbee elley v'ayn.
Myr shoh ren Baase fer ass billey tramman va ny hassoo faggys da.
Yn nah vraar, by vie lesh injillaghey Baase ny smoo foast,
as hirr eh yn ablid dy hayrn sluight ennoil da er-ash veih'n oaie.
Myr shoh ren Baase pluggey clagh veih'n awin, as darr eh da yn ee shen.
Fy yerrey hoal, hyndaa Baase gys y trass vraar.
Dooinney imlee myr v'eh, hirr eshyn ersyn son red ennagh verragh pooar da dy gholl roish veih'n voayl shen,
gyn Baase eiyrt ersyn. As
shen myr ve dy dug Baase dy neuarryltagh dasyn y Cloagey dy Neuakinaght by leshyn hene.
Hie yn chied vraar gys balley beg cheerey foddey,
as ayns shen, as y slat obbee tramman ayns e laue,
varr eh fer obbee, rishyn ren eh troiddey keayrt dy row.
Er-meshtey lesh y phooar hug y slat obbee tramman da, ren eh boggys ass dy row eh neuvainshtyragh.
Agh yn oie shen, ren fer obbee elley geid y slat obbee
as ren eh scoltey scoarnagh y vraar son dooraght.
As myr shoh, ghow Baase yn chied vraar er e hon hene.
Hie y nah vraar gys e hie as hyndaa eh y chlagh tree keayrtyn 'sy laue echey.
Hug eh taitnys da, y
neen v'eh jerkal rish poosey keayrt dy row roish e baase antraaoil, haink ish rish roishyn.
Agh dy leah v'ee trimshagh as feayr er yn oyr nagh row ee bentyn da'n theihll marvaanagh.
Ass e cheeayl lesh foaddeeaght gyn doghys, varr y nah vraar eh hene, dy ve cooidjagh ree.
As myr shoh ghow Baase y nah vraar.
As bentyn da'n trass vraar, yeeagh Baase er-e-hon rish ymmodee bleeantyn, agh cha noddagh eh rieau feddyn eh.
Cha row eh derrey va eash vooar ersyn dy dug y braar saa jehsyn y Cloagey dy Neuakinaght as hug
eh eh da'n vac echey.
As eisht hug eh bannaght er Baase myr shenn charrey,
as hie eh roish marish dy gennal, faagail y vea shoh,
as adsyn corrym dy cheilley.
